categories.main_business_segments: Aero Win Technology Corporation primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of aerospace engine components, including mechanical processing and thin sheet metal forming. The company also produces and refurbishes components for ground gas turbines used in power generation. Their product portfolio includes parts for aircraft engines such as LEAP, PW1200G, and CF34, serving major aerospace engine manufacturers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including superalloy and titanium alloy forming, welding, heat treatment, surface treatment, and precision machining. They employ automated processes and 5-axis laser technology for large components, integrating multiple processes such as machining, sheet metal forming, and welding. Quality assurance systems compliant with aerospace standards like ISO9001, AS9100, and Nadcap are implemented to ensure product reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major aerospace engine manufacturers such as Safran Group (France) and Pratt & Whitney (USA). The company supplies engine components for various aircraft engines including LEAP series, PW1000G series, and CFM56. The primary markets are aerospace and power generation sectors, with sales concentrated in the United States, Europe, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and manufacturing facilities are located in Tainan, Taiwan. The company serves global aerospace markets, with significant sales to customers in the United States, Europe, and Japan. There is no mention of overseas subsidiaries or branches, indicating a Taiwan-based manufacturing and export model.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aero Win Technology operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the aerospace supply chain, manufacturing critical engine components and assemblies. They are positioned as a Tier 2 or Tier 3 supplier providing parts to major engine manufacturers (Tier 1) who assemble complete engines for aircraft OEMs like Boeing and Airbus.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in aerospace component manufacturing, investing around 6.4% of annual revenue in R&D. Short-term plans include automation to increase efficiency and capacity expansion, with development of new parts like swirlers and Boeing components. Mid-term goals involve optimizing processes and equipment for semiconductor and green energy sectors, while long-term plans target adapting to next-generation engine technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of aerospace engine components and assemblies. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery or shipment of parts to customers under agreed terms. There is no indication of subscription or licensing models; income is based on manufacturing contracts and long-term supply agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the aerospace component manufacturing industry, supplying to top-tier engine manufacturers. While specific competitors are not named, Aero Win is positioned as a trusted supplier with certifications and long-term contracts with major global engine makers. Their competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing capabilities, cost-effective production in Asia, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net sales of approximately NT$824 million, a 20.5% increase from the previous year, with net profit of NT$102 million and EPS of NT$1.49. Total assets grew by 41% to NT$2.13 billion, supported by significant capital investments in property and equipment. The company shows a positive growth trajectory driven by increased orders and market recovery post-pandemic.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aero Win emphasizes high-quality aerospace components manufactured under stringent international standards with advanced technologies. Their value proposition includes reliable delivery, process innovation, and cost competitiveness due to integrated manufacturing capabilities and location advantages. The company’s long-term contracts with leading engine manufacturers reflect customer trust in their quality and technical expertise.
